situation: A Zotero restore assigns new numeric itemIDs to works that already have claims and evidence spans. The old local IDs no longer join reliably, and some works may lack DOIs.
required_decision: REKEY_DURABLE_IDENTITY: Rejoin works through persisted zotero_key and DOI where available, keep itemID local, and preserve claim and evidence links through a verified old-to-new mapping.
required_unknowns: DOI_AVAILABILITY: which affected works lack a DOI and need another verified durable join
REIMPORT_KEY_MAPPING: whether the old itemID to zotero_key and new itemID mapping has been verified
forbidden_action: USE_CONTENT_HASH_AS_IDENTITY: treating a content hash as paper identity
